label: Bible Study
prompt: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; _____ to that which is good.
verse: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.
note: Love without faking it — hate the evil, and hold on tight to the good.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him but a few days, for the _____ he had to her.
verse: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him but a few days, for the love he had to her.
note: Seven years felt like a few days to Jacob — that's what love does to a calendar.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Josiah was _____ years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jedidah, the daughter of Adaiah of Boscath.
verse: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jedidah, the daughter of Adaiah of Boscath.
note: Josiah became king at eight years old — and grew up to lead one of Judah's greatest revivals.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Henceforth there is laid up for me a _____ of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.
verse: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.
note: Paul's last letter, with his 'departure' at hand: the crown isn't for him only, but all who love his appearing.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And they went forth, and preached every where, the Lord working with them, and _____ the word with signs following. Amen.
verse: And they went forth, and preached every where, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.
note: Mark's Gospel closes with the apostles preaching everywhere and the Lord 'confirming the word with signs following.'
